name: Cycling
notes: Indoor or outdoor ride tracked by distance and elapsed time.

guide.setup: Set the saddle so the knee has a slight bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke, with relaxed hands on the bars.
guide.execution: Pedal smoothly at a sustainable cadence and shift resistance or gears to match the planned effort.
guide.cues: Relax the shoulders. Keep a steady cadence. Breathe rhythmically.
guide.mistakes: A saddle that is too low; gripping the bars tightly; grinding a hard gear; starting too fast.

images.caption: Steady cycling effort with posture relaxed and cadence controlled.
